name: Immanence
desc: This Skill represents the continual pursuit of higher things. You can use Immanence to intuit abstractions, comprehend complex problems, and construct logical connections.

name: Action
desc: This Skill represents the practiced, instant exercise of force. You can use Action to impose your strength, perform athletic feats, make snap judgements, and resolve problems under pressure.

name: Potence
desc: This Skill represents trained coordination through time. You can use Potence to balance yourself, to make and execute plans, construct inferences, hypothesize, and intuit danger.
